You are a hosted-E2E operator on freytag-forge. Your working directory is the real repository /home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge. This task runs WITHOUT a sandbox and spends real money (OpenAI blind player plus Cloudflare narration), so read the hard rules first.

HARD RULES. Change nothing except: files under artifacts/e2e-* and frontend/test-results/ (generated, gitignored) and the output directory /home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge/bench/results/stage7-blind-raw/attempt-1/ . Do not edit or create any tracked file. No git add/commit/checkout/stash/reset/clean/push. Never print, echo, copy or upload .env or any token; `source .env` only inside the commands below. Staging only: if the API reports any channel other than staging, stop and report. Run the blind-player test AT MOST ONCE - never retry a failed or aborted run, because every attempt counts. Do not run anything else billed. Do not edit code to make a run pass.

WHAT THIS IS: Stage 7 step 1 of .plans/implementation_plan.md. One raw-profile, all-scenes blind-player run (frontend/e2e/blind-player.spec.js) on staging. Stopping rule fixed in advance: exactly one attempt, no replacement; if the smoke fails twice or a quota/budget stop (HTTP 429 with X-Narration-Error-Code AI_QUOTA_EXCEEDED or AI_DAILY_BUDGET_EXCEEDED) appears, stop and record it.

STEPS, in order:
1. Identity: `mkdir -p bench/results/stage7-blind-raw/attempt-1 && source .env && curl -s "$E2E_API_BASE_URL/api/v1/version" > bench/results/stage7-blind-raw/attempt-1/identity.json`. Required channel 'staging', runtime 'scene-v1'. Expected sha 8aba3ba37a927eb58103633bff69c5cab71b6950; if different, record it and stop without running anything billed (write run-failure.txt 'NOT RUN: sha mismatch' and smoke-result.txt 'not run').
2. Smoke: `rm -f artifacts/e2e-smoke-loaded.png; source .env && cd frontend && npm run test:e2e -- --grep @smoke`. If it fails once rerun once; if it still fails write the verbatim output to run-failure.txt, smoke-result.txt 'failed', and do NOT run the blind player. Write smoke-result.txt with 'passed' or 'failed' plus attempts.
3. Delete stale artifacts: `rm -f artifacts/e2e-blind-player*.json artifacts/e2e-blind-player*.md`.
4. Blind run: `source .env && cd frontend && E2E_BLIND_SCENE=all BLIND_PLAYER_PROFILE=raw E2E_BLIND_REPLICATES=1 E2E_TURN_TIMEOUT_MS=90000 npm run test:e2e -- --grep @blind-player` with a command timeout of at least 90 minutes. The command may exit nonzero (a failure is data, not a reason to rerun). Save the last 80 lines of output, secrets stripped, to attempt-1/run-tail.txt.
5. Copy every artifacts/e2e-blind-player*.json and .md (if they exist) into attempt-1/. If the run died before writing a report, write the verbatim failure text to attempt-1/run-failure.txt. Never copy a report that predates step 3.
6. Write attempt-1/operator-note.md (about 150 words, strictly factual): sha, smoke result, whether the test passed, scenes reached, turns, stuck/rejection/game-break counts if the report has them, failure text verbatim. Quote, do not interpret. An honest failed or skipped attempt is a good result.
